newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF Sakakibara to address meeting on Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF Sakakibara to address meeting on Sept 11.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director- general of the Japanese Finance Ministry's (MOF) International Finance Bureau, will speak at a meeting of business leaders on Wednesday September 11, organisers said on Friday.
Sakakibara will discuss financial issues, including currency and interest rates, organisers added.
The meeting, hosted by publishers of the magazine Zaikai, will be held from 8.00-9.30 a.m. (2300-0030 GMT) and will be closed to the press.
Sakakibara is widely seen as the key figure in pushing the dollar back up from its postwar low hit in the spring of 1995. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk (81-3-5473-3710)
